lib/link-preview.ts.name: Hover card data
lib/link-preview.ts.description: Builds a page's hover-card JSON: description, the lead before the first heading, and clipped text per heading id.

lib/llms-index.ts.name: llms.txt formatter
lib/llms-index.ts.description: Reshapes Fumadocs' llms index to master's title and summary, links each page's .md mirror, and lists every page once.

lib/llms-tracking.ts.name: Markdown fetch tracking
lib/llms-tracking.ts.description: Classifies a markdown or llms*.txt request by bot user agent and path, and builds the PostHog llms_file_fetched payload.

lib/markdown-redirects.ts.name: Markdown redirect twins
lib/markdown-redirects.ts.description: Derives a .md redirect twin for each redirect that lands on a docs page, skipping public files, external and pattern sources.
